title: DevOps Engineer (Russian) (Infrastructure)
description:
Grow-Talent.com is working with an award winning liquidity and technology solutions company who is seeking to onboard a Russian speaking DevOps Engineer to join their team.
 Position: DevOps Engineer 
 Location: Remote/ GMT +4 timezone (+- 1 HR)
 Employment type: Full-time
 Remuneration: Base salary
 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
 Oversee the maintenance and enhancement of existing infrastructure and CI/CD workflows

 Troubleshoot and resolve deployment issues in both test and production environments

 Configure and manage monitoring and logging systems

 Contribute to incident analysis and resolution efforts

 Collaborate regularly with the product team to ensure alignment and support

 REQUIREMENTS: 
 
 Native/Fluency in Russian (C1 level), with strong proficiency in both written and spoken communication

 Strong knowledge and understanding of the following;

 Proficiency in CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI)

 Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g. Kubernetes)

 Expertise in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Shell)

 Experience with monitoring and logging solutions 

 Knowledge of network stack

 In-depth knowledge of networking, security protocols, and system architecture

 Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in both development and production environments

 Ability to collaborate effectively with development, QA, and operations teams

 Experience with Service Mesh solutions

 OFFER: 
 
 Exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly growing fintech platform

 Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

 Collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and problem-solving

 Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement

 Flexible working arrangements and a comprehensive benefits package

 Originally posted on Himalayas
